parsed.rationale: Both `RemoteCommandProtocol` (line 17) and `SkipIntervalCommandProtocol` (line 24) are declared in the same file `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/RemoteCommandCenterProtocol.swift` within the `Playback` package, and `SkipIntervalCommandProtocol` is a strict superset of `RemoteCommandProtocol`: it shares all three members (`addTarget:`, `isEnabled:Bool`, `removeTarget:`) and adds only `preferredIntervals:[NSNumber]`. Making `SkipIntervalCommandProtocol` inherit from `RemoteCommandProtocol` eliminates the three duplicated member declarations, expresses the natural subtype relationship (a skip-interval command is-a remote command), and allows any code typed to `RemoteCommandProtocol` to accept skip-interval commands polymorphically. No restraint markers are present on either record.
